title: Vendor Pre-Qualification: Infrastructure Works for Gold Loan Branches, PAN India
scope: Project development services for new gold loan branch offices: civil, interior, carpentry, loose furniture and fixtures, electrical works. Non-IT infrastructure package. Typical branch carpet area about 750 sq ft.

questions.text: Legal name of the entity
Constitution of the entity (Proprietorship, Partnership, LLP, Private Limited, Public Limited)
Year of incorporation or registration
Registered office address
Name and designation of the authorised contact person
Email address of the contact person
Mobile number of the contact person
GST registration number
PAN
Corporate Identity Number (CIN), if applicable
Is the entity registered as an MSME under Udyam?
Name of the proprietor or directors and their relevant experience
Annual turnover for the last three financial years, with audited statements
Net worth as per the latest audited balance sheet
Name of the principal banker
Attach a bank solvency certificate not older than one year

questions.required_document: Audited financial statements for the last three years
questions.text: Attach audited financial statements for the last three financial years
Total number of employees on payroll
Break-up of technical staff: engineers, supervisors, skilled technicians and labour
Do you have an in-house factory for modular furniture? If not, describe your sourcing arrangement
Describe your electrical works capability and licences held
List of major tools, plant and equipment owned
Number of years in the interior fit-out business
Describe your experience executing bank or NBFC branch fit-outs, with client names, number of branches and approximate area
Details of the largest single project executed: client, scope, value and year
List of clients served in the last five years
Details of projects currently in progress
Attach work completion certificates for at least three similar projects
Attach client reference letters with contact details
Which zones or states can you serve? Indicate your preferred zone if PAN India is not feasible
How many branch sites can you execute simultaneously?
Typical turnaround time from site handover to completion for a 750 sq ft branch
Do you hold ISO 9001 certification? Attach the certificate
Do you have a documented quality manual? Attach
Do you have a documented environment, health and safety policy? Attach
Describe your safety record over the last five years, including any reportable accidents
Attach EPFO registration certificate
Attach ESIC registration certificate
Has the entity ever been blacklisted or debarred by any bank, NBFC, corporate or government body? Give details
Details of any litigation or arbitration pending or concluded in the last five years
Attach certificate of incorporation or registration
Attach GST registration certificate
Attach PAN card copy
